## Submission rules (read first)

- ❌ Do NOT submit official game assets (BRF/SCO/DDS models, textures or scenes, DLL/EXE binaries, audio, fonts, game text/data).
- ❌ Do NOT submit decompiled, cracked, or otherwise unlawfully extracted content from game binaries.
- ❌ Do NOT request that official game files be bundled or distributed with this project.
- ✅ This repository accepts only original code and documentation written by the project author (MIT scope).

Issues or PRs violating these rules will be closed. Violating any compliance rule leads to
project termination and repository deletion.
